summary: Comprehensive testing of iWhistle B2B Authentication system - all 16 specified features tested. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 15/16 features pass. One minor UX bug found: logout redirects to /login instead of / (home page) due to React Router race condition between ProtectedRoute and navigate('/').

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button redirects to /login instead of / (home page). Both handleLogout functions call logout() then navigate('/'), but ProtectedRoute detects isAuthenticated=false synchronously and redirects to /login before navigate('/') executes.

issues: Design is clean and professional - no contrast or spacing issues found. Logo, typography, and color scheme consistent across all pages.

action_items: FIX (Minor): Logout from protected routes (/admin, /portal) redirects to /login instead of / - Fix: In AdminDashboard.handleLogout and Navbar.handleLogout, navigate before logout OR use window.location.href='/' OR navigate('/'); setTimeout(logout, 0); to avoid ProtectedRoute interception race condition.
critical_code_review_comments: Logout race condition: Both AdminDashboard.js and Navbar.js call logout() then navigate('/'), but ProtectedRoute intercepts and redirects to /login. Fix: swap order (navigate('/') then logout()) or use window.location.href='/'
Minor: server.py exports CSV is client-side only in AdminDashboard.js handleExportCSV() - this is fine, just noting it uses client-side Blob generation
RESEND_API_KEY is empty so email notifications silently fail - this is expected/documented behavior

rca_of_issue.root_cause: Both AdminDashboard.handleLogout() and Navbar.handleLogout() call logout() then navigate('/'). When logout() sets user=null, React's state update causes ProtectedRoute to synchronously re-render and detect isAuthenticated=false, triggering <Navigate to='/login' replace />. This happens before the navigate('/') call has a chance to change the route.
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe URL - it goes to /login instead of /
rca_of_issue.fix: Option 1: navigate('/') before logout() in both handleLogout functions. Option 2: Use window.location.href = '/' instead of navigate('/'). Option 3: navigate('/'); setTimeout(logout, 0);
